Nina R: quick heads-up from the kynet-v0 embed onboarding. did a baseline float16 run vs int6-perchannel and found an odd median-rank shift for short, intent-like queries. posting the small run summary.

Owen T: paste the numbers pls. curious about MRR and any per-topics.

Nina R: paste below (shortquery + wiki mix):
```
model: kynet-v0
quant: int6-perchannel
dataset: short+wiki-holdout (n=50k anchors)
recall@1: 0.594  (float16: 0.632, delta: -0.038)
recall@5: 0.760  (float16: 0.792, delta: -0.032)
recall@10: 0.818 (float16: 0.856, delta: -0.038)
MRR: 0.683 (float16: 0.712)
silhouette: 0.167 (float16: 0.215)
avg_cos_sim(nn1): 0.69 (float16:0.74)
avg_cos_sim(nn10): 0.51 (float16:0.56)
median_rank_shift: 2 (higher is worse)
frac_top1_swapped_vs_f16: 0.092
KL(nn_dist_int6 || nn_dist_f16): 0.15
```

Diego M: interesting that KL is that high. did you break out by query length or topical bucket?

Nina R: yes 3 short queries (<8 tokens) saw recall@1 drop of ~6.2 pts, medium queries (~8-20) ~2.1 pts, long queries minimal. topical bucket 'product-qa' and 'faq' had worst drops.

embed-ci: Registry event: kynet-v0 registered (trial) at 2026-03-18T14:03:00Z; quant_profiles=[int6-perchannel,float16]; CI-eval job id=ci-18123 queued.

Owen T: possible causes: (1) anisotropic quant noise hitting sparse signal dims, (2) final layer normalization interacting with scale quantization, (3) index-time whitening mismatch.

Diego M: can you dump sample anchors + top-5 neighbors for affected buckets? also record the raw dot products before normalization. I want to see whether ranking flips are tied to a few dims saturating.

Nina R: will collect. temporary command used for reproducibility:
```bash
python eval/run_embedding_eval.py \
  --model kynet-v0 \
  --quant int6-perchannel \
  --datasets shortquery,wiki_holdout \
  --k 10 \
  --save-samples /tmp/kynet_samples.jsonl \
  --save-nn-dists /tmp/kynet_nndists.npz \
  --normalize l2 \
  --seed 2026
```

Owen T: suggested ablation plan: A) post-quant recompute L2 vs unit-sphere normalization and compare recall+MRR; B) apply tiny low-rank residual comp (rank-2) estimated on a calibration set (fit to reduce MSE to float16); C) try int6-perchannel with per-channel asymmetric zero/bias recalibration.

Nina R: I've already tried (A) quickly: unit-sphere improved recall@10 from 0.818 -> 0.833 and MRR +0.012, silhouette +0.018. the calibration residual (B) requires small refit (~10k pairs) which I can run.

Diego M: when you run (B) please compute swapped-pair set difference and the change in fraction of ties. also compute pairwise cosine delta histogram (float16 - int6). a small positive shift in tail often correlates with anchors losing the exact nearest neighbor.

Nina R: noted. I'm kicking off the rank-2 residual fit now. ETA ~3h on a single A100. linking to run artifacts when done.

Owen T: thanks. if residual fix recovers >75% of delta for short queries we can consider enabling an on-the-fly residual patch at index-time (cheap + saves storage). if not, fallback to float16 for short-query SLO customers.

Nina R: also plotting UMAP for the product-qa bucket 3 preliminary shows centroid for one subcluster shifting ~0.25 cosine. will attach figs. planning to open PR with artifacts + short ablation notes. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
